name: LENA
summary: LENA proposed a 50-kiloton liquid-scintillator observatory with broad solar, geoneutrino and supernova-neutrino capabilities. Its technical studies examined a large underground cylindrical detector at European candidate sites. LENA is a historical proposal; an operating 50-kiloton LENA detector is not established by the reviewed sources.
detection_principle: Scintillation light from inverse beta decay, neutrino-electron scattering and neutrino interactions on carbon would provide low-threshold calorimetry. Photomultiplier coverage and a surrounding veto would suppress radioactive and cosmic backgrounds.

status.label: Historical proposal
status.evidence: The design white paper and later physics studies describe a proposed detector. Candidate-site and sensitivity studies are not construction or operational milestones.
